mergePolicy: Merge validated task commits into main; use isolated executor worktrees/branches per task.
queuePolicy: Execute C1-INFRA first. After it passes, queue the C1 parallel block from docs/AGENT_PLAN.md with file ownership and acceptance criteria.
validationCommands: cd ui && npm install && npm run build

tasks.title: Postgres + Docker + Schema
tasks.description: Implement docs/AGENT_PLAN.md C1-INFRA. Bootstrap Engram v2 infrastructure around Postgres 16 + pgvector, schema application, test DB config, environment examples, and SQLite-to-Postgres migration script. Reconcile with current repo reality: docker-compose.yml, .env.example, docs/SCHEMA.sql, and scripts/apply_schema.sh already exist, but docker-compose.test.yml and scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_postgres.py are missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Docker Compose defines Postgres 16 + pgvector services for dev and test usage without committing secrets
docker-compose.test.yml or equivalent test service path exposes test Postgres on port 5433
.env.example documents DATABASE_URL and TEST_DATABASE_URL for v2
scripts/apply_schema.sh applies docs/SCHEMA.sql to DATABASE_URL safely
scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_postgres.py can run against a SQLite copy and target Postgres, validates table row counts, and exits nonzero on mismatch
Schema validation confirms the seven canonical tables from docs/SCHEMA.sql exist in the test database
